lines.text: Many learners say: How do you think about it?
Better: What do you think about it?
What! What do you think about it?

data.wrong: How do you think about it?
data.right: What do you think about it?

native.tip: 한국어 “어떻게 생각해요?”의 “어떻게”를 How로 옮기기 쉬워요. 영어는 What! “What do you think?”예요.
native.caption: “How do you think about it?”라고 말하고 있나요? 😅 한국어 “어떻게 생각해요?”를 그대로 옮기면 How가 돼요. 영어는 What을 써요. “What do you think about it?”이 맞아요. Ama 선생님을 따라 말해 보세요! Lexkite 앱에서 더 연습해요.
native.comment: 정답: “What”. What do you think? 무료 퀴즈로 더 연습해 보세요: {link}

en.tip: Korean says “how do you think”, so people use how. English uses what. Say “What do you think about it?”
en.caption: Do you say “How do you think about it”? 😅 To ask for an opinion, use what. “What do you think about it?” is right. Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
